A small treasure hidden in the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}, on the island of Svargrond. Follow the path through the mines to a room with a barrel: inside is a fur bag with a {item:Berserk Potion}, 82 gp and a {item:Waterskin} of {item:Mead}.
Access to the Formorgar Mines: you get it by accepting mission 9 of the {wiki:Ice Islands Quest|Ice Islands Quest}.
